
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_54135289">
这两天发现一个比较经典的项目：ReactOS<br>
其本意是做一款开源的能够兼容Windows的操作系统，<br>
，不过到目前为止也只是做到了XP系统的兼容……<br>
（可以直接双击运行EXE，不过由于一些库的缺失其实很多软件也用不了……）<br>
所以可以把它看作WinXP模拟器？<br>
主要占用的资源确实比XP小很多，<a href="https://www.52pojie.cn/thread-661779-1-1.html" target="_blank" class="relatedlink">虚拟机</a>安装完之后硬盘占用只有400MB不到，在占用上也确实是低于XP,内存占用大概在70MB左右<br>
<br>
下面就开始安装虚拟机<br>
本人虚拟机使用的是VMWare17.6.4 build-24832109<br>
（其实我估计低版本VM也不会有影响，毕竟这系统VM就一直没做过兼容，也没什么人会去用）<br>
新建虚拟机：直接选典型就行<br>
<img id="aimg_jY2PY" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b446d2272_1761915974.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b446d2272_1761915974.webp"><br>
<br>
然后选稍后安装操作系统：（其实直接选中映像文件也行，但由于VM没做兼容，无法检测，两个都要手动指定OS类型，也没啥区别）<br>
<img id="aimg_bAcKH" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b48b122e2_1761916043.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b48b122e2_1761916043.webp"><br>
<br>
这里我选的64位（但其实不选64位也不会有太大问题）<br>
<img id="aimg_rchh7" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="715" height="881" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b49078b04_1761916048.webp" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b49078b04_1761916048.webp"><br>
名称啥的各位随意：<br>
<img id="aimg_R3Nhf" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b491df66b_1761916049.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b491df66b_1761916049.webp"><br>
<br>
硬盘默认就行（也占不了那么大……）<br>
<img id="aimg_iZzlK" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b493a700a_1761916051.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b493a700a_1761916051.webp"><br>
有一点，硬盘格式应该是默认FAT32的，太大了也不好（一般也不会有人故意搞吧……）<br>
<br>
自定义硬件也是默认就行：<br>
<img id="aimg_aEam5" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b494e8084_1761916052.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b494e8084_1761916052.webp"><br>
<br>
安装之前别忘了选中光盘映像：<br>
<img id="aimg_K0PNR" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b4965f4bd_1761916054.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b4965f4bd_1761916054.webp"><br>
<br>
然后开启虚拟机：<br>
<img id="aimg_Ff2FZ" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b498552c2_1761916056.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b498552c2_1761916056.webp"><br>
<br>
会弹出以下界面：<br>
<img id="aimg_EngYq" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b499dc832_1761916057.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b499dc832_1761916057.webp"><br>
如果要用简体中文的话选择Chinese（PRC）就行<br>
PRC是中华人民共和国的缩写，跟一般使用的简体中文的翻译略有不同<br>
<br>
然后一路按回车（大概就是你要不要安装系统、磁盘分区咋分，但这里我们只是体验一下，不用太在意）<br>
<img id="aimg_M0Q2V" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b49b25c0d_1761916059.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6904b49b25c0d_1761916059.webp"><br>

<br>
开始安装，虽然我只分配了256MB内存和一个处理器核（有点像黑老板），但安装还是能跑的很快<br>
<img id="aimg_UGk7Z" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z3emet.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z3emet.webp"><br>
等待重启，或者自己按下回车都行<br>
<br>
重启后会进入系统初次安装的设置环节（这一部分也跟Windows一模一样&amp;#128517;）这里是因为是因为我截图之前忘记把语言调整成中文了……调整完之后这一部分都是中文……<br>
<img id="aimg_v0NM7" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z3ew4k.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z3ew4k.webp"><br>
NEXT后进入开源项目的声明：<br>
<img id="aimg_fo5Zm" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z43ipe.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z43ipe.webp"><br>
<br>
再次NEXT后进入操作系统版本的选择，分为工作站和服务器，我这里选的工作站：<br>
<img id="aimg_KQG44" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z43pbe.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z43pbe.webp"><br>
<br>
然后会跟你说XX版本的个人文件放在哪儿之类的，一般不用管（毕竟我们只是体验一下哈）<br>
<img id="aimg_wjJ6P" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z43to6.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z43to6.webp"><br>
<br>
接下来设置用户名和组织名称（组织名称不设置也没事）<br>
<img id="aimg_glbwb" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4466o.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4466o.webp"><br>
<br>
然后是计算机名称和管理员密码（不设置就是没有）<br>
<img id="aimg_Lczyc" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z440zd.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z440zd.webp"><br>
<br>
NEXT会进入时区选择，一般跟语言是绑定的：<br>
<img id="aimg_Vh8dj" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z448x4.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z448x4.webp"><br>
<br>
下一步会选择系统外观，其实都挺不符合现代审美的，classic完美还原了win95等古早版本的外观……<br>
<img id="aimg_Xf9kz" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z44if7.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z44if7.webp"><br>
<br>
进入网络配置，默认就行<br>
<img id="aimg_ys8U0" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4vwxz.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4vwxz.webp"><br>
<br>
设置域，没需求就纯体验，默认不设置就行<br>
<img id="aimg_BvKuz" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4w54u.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4w54u.webp"><br>
<br>
再一次NEXT就是正式设置（太快了，没截下图……&amp;#128557;&amp;#128588;）<br>
最后会设置完重启<br>
<br>
重启完后跳出驱动安装：<br>
<img id="aimg_ZSypy" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4w428.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4w428.webp"><br>
依旧是默认NEXT（多半找不到驱动，然后finish就行）<br>
<br>
最后就进入桌面：<br>
<img id="aimg_pxel7" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4wc3j.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4wc3j.webp"><br>
<br>
实际情况是，你越体验越觉得它就是Windows……<br>
真的太像了………………<br>
<br>
打开任务管理器可以看到系统开销（真就照搬win美（答）学（辩））：<br>
<img id="aimg_b9uTN" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4wi3j.webp" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="http://image.aibochinese.com/i/2025/10/31/z4wi3j.webp"><br>
此处有一个BUG？就是如果设置多核处理器的话，刚开机直接启动任务管理器会显示CPU占用100%<br>
但是你一启动什么别的软件，就会恢复正常显示（比如自带的扫雷）<br>
另外内存如果分配的太大也会出现意料之外的情况，比如显示总数不对之类的，<br>
如果有大佬知道原因的话求答案&amp;#128571;<br>
<br>
（小白，但怕号无，不知道发啥，只能发一些没啥技术含量的东西了，望大佬见谅……）<br>
